verses.en: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morasthite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Isaraelu ona o a latou amio O le afioga a le ALII na 00 mai :a Mika le Morese i ona po o Iotama, ma Aasa, ma Esekia, o tupu o Iuta, na ia iloa i mea a Samaria ma Ierusalema.

verses.en: Hear, all ye people; hearken, O earth, and all that therein is: and let the Lord GOD be witness against you, the Lord from his holy temple.
verses.sm: Faalogologo mai ia outou nuu uma; faasaga rnai ia le lalolagi e, atoa ma mea ua tumu ai, seia fai e le Alii le ATUA ana mau ia te outou, o le Alii lava ai lona malumalu paia.

verses.en: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
verses.sm: Aua faauta, o loo afio mai le ALII ai lona afioaga, e afio ifo o ia, ma soli i mea maualuluga o i le lalolagi.

verses.en: And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place.
verses.sm: E liu suavai mauga i lalo ia te ia, e mávaevae vanu, pei o le pulu i le afi, faapei o le vai ua tafe ifo i le tofé.

verses.en: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, and for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
verses.sm: Ona o le solitulafono a lakopo e oo ai ia mea uma, ona o agasala foi a le aiga o Isaraelu. Se a ea le solitulafono a lakopo? E le o Samaria ea? O a ea foi mea maualuluga a Iuta? E le o Ierusalema ea?

verses.en: Therefore I will make Samaria as an heap of the field, and as plantings of a vineyard: and I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, and I will discover the foundations thereof.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te fai ai Samaria ma faupuegamaa i le fanua, ma mea e totò ai vine, ou te tuleia foi i lalo i le vanu ona maa, faalautele le mea ua tafia pei o le ou te faataatitiafuaina ona faavae.

verses.en: And all the graven images thereof shall be beaten to pieces, and all the hires thereof shall be burned with the fire, and all the idols thereof will I lay desolate: for she gathered it of the hire of an harlot, and they shall return to the hire of an harlot.
verses.sm: E nutininiia foi ona tupua ua ta uma, e susunuina foi ona taui uma i le afi, ou te faatafunaina foi ona tupua uma; aua o le taui o le fafine talitane na ia faaputuina ai, e toe foi atu foi ia mea i le taui o le fafine talitane.

verses.en: Therefore I will wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked: I will make a wailing like the dragons, and mourning as the owls.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te tagitu‘i ai, ma ou uio, ou te fealuai ma le le ofu ma le le lavalavā; ou te tagi pei o luko, ma ou faanoanoa pei o iaena.

verses.en: For her wound is incurable; for it is come unto Judah; he is come unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Aua e leaga ona manua; aua ua oo lava i luta; ua paia lava le faitotoa o loʻu nuu, o Ierusalema lava.

verses.en: Declare ye it not at Gath, weep ye not at all: in the house of Aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
verses.sm: ro Aua ne“ ta‘uatua i Kato, aua neʻi fetagisi i Ako; ia e taafili i le efuefu i Petofira.

verses.en: Pass ye away, thou inhabitant of Saphir, having thy shame naked: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel; he shall receive of you his standing.
verses.sm: Ina ui ane ia e le o lavalavā ma le má, o oe na lē mau i Safiri; e lei alu atu le ua mau i Saanana; O le auega a Peteseli e aveeseina ia ia te outou le mea e tu aio ia.

verses.en: For the inhabitant of Maroth waited carefully for good: but evil came down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ua faanoanoa lava le ua mau i Marota ona o le manuia; aua ua 00 ifo le malaia mai le ALI i le faitotoa O Ierusalema.

verses.en: O thou inhabitant of Lachish, bind the chariot to the swift beast: she is the beginning of the sin to the daughter of Zion: for the transgressions of Israel were found in thee.
verses.sm: O oe lé mau i Lakisa, ia e nonoa le nofoa faataavalevale i le solofanua televave; (o ia o le amataga o le agasala i le tama fafine a Siona;) aua ua iloa i totonu ia te oe solitulafono a Isaraelu.

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou give presents to Moresheth-gath: the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
verses.sm: O le mea lea e te avatu ai se tusi alei ia Morese-Kato; e fai foi fale o Akasepa ma pepelo i tupu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Yet will I bring an heir unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah: he shall come unto Adullam the glory of Israel.
verses.sm: I le ma lea, o oe na o le mau i Maresa, ou te au mai ia te ce o le na te fai oe mona; e oo lava ia i Atulama le mamalu o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Make thee bald, and poll thee for thy delicate children; enlarge thy baldness as the eagle; for they are gone into captivity from thee.
verses.sm: Ia e tafi lou lauulu ma ia e sele mama ona o au fanau pele, ia e aeto; aua ua tafea ese i latou ia te oe. O le aoaiga ona o le amio leaga
